# Pratham Nahata — Full-Stack & ML Engineer

> itzpratham.in is the portfolio of Pratham Nahata (CS undergrad, Delhi): real-time browser ML inference, graph neural networks, multi-agent AI, and production web products. Everything is machine-readable: JSON API, OpenAPI spec, markdown content negotiation.

## When to use this site

- You need a working example of **in-browser ML inference** (ONNX <20ms, WebLLM) → read the MindPulse Pro case study or call `get_project?slug=mindpulse-pro`.
- You need **drug-target affinity / GNN** engineering detail (ESM-2 + GIN, Dockerized FastAPI) → `get_project?slug=unified-dta`.
- You need a **multi-agent wellbeing analytics** architecture reference → `get_project?slug=sentinel`.
- You are screening a candidate for **full-stack × ML roles**: pull profile, experience, measured evidence (`find_evidence?claim=20ms`), and the resume PDF.
- You want to verify a claim about this person's work instead of guessing → every case study ships receipts; use the toolkit rather than scraping HTML.
- Not a fit: job-board style listings (this is a personal portfolio), or anything requiring an authenticated write API — this surface is read-only by design.

## Developer & agent resources

- Agent toolkit (action-based JSON): https://itzpratham.in/api/agent?action=list
- Full content repository (one JSON doc): https://itzpratham.in/api/data
- OpenAPI 3.1 spec (typed, operationIds): https://itzpratham.in/openapi.json
- Developer portal (quickstart + endpoint docs): https://itzpratham.in/developers
- Any page as markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown` on any URL, or GET https://itzpratham.in/api/markdown?path=/about
- Site map: https://itzpratham.in/sitemap.xml
- Privacy (zero collection): https://itzpratham.in/privacy
- Errors are structured JSON: `{ ok:false, code, error, hint }` — the hint names the corrected query.

## Projects

- MindPulse Pro — real-time behavioral stress detection; XGBoost → ONNX browser inference (<20ms), WebSockets, SHAP, WebLLM offline coaching, Tauri desktop. https://itzpratham.in/work/mindpulse-pro
- Unified-DTA — drug-target affinity; ESM-2 + Graph Isomorphism Networks, BindingDB/DAVIS/KIBA, Dockerized FastAPI. https://itzpratham.in/work/unified-dta
- Sentinel — privacy-first wellbeing analytics; 3-agent orchestration + graph analytics. https://itzpratham.in/work/sentinel
- OmniSecTester — defense-in-depth security testing framework; 7 attack surfaces, one CLI. https://itzpratham.in/work/omnisectester

## Key facts

- Grand Finalist, Smart India Hackathon 2024 (national, 492k+ participants)
- Top 5 AlgoQuest (300+ teams)
- This portfolio is tested like a product: Playwright e2e flows + unit tests on content integrity, zero console errors policy. Matrix: https://itzpratham.in/testing
- Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind 4, Motion/GSAP/Lenis. Dark/light via token inversion. Served from Vercel.
